parameters.content:
## Aggregator

Finds the newest run manifest, reads per-repo status logs, computes a report
(done/missing chunks, failed repos), writes `summaries/<runId>.json` and
`.md`, posts an optional Slack summary and purges runs older than
PURGE_AFTER_DAYS.

Schedule is a guess: dispatch at 02:00, report at 05:30. Tune the cron to
match how long your fleet takes to drain.

parameters.command: RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; MF=$(ls -t "$RUN_ROOT/manifests/"*.txt 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); echo "MF=$MF"; [ -n "$MF" ] && cat "$MF"

RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; echo "===COUNTS==="; for p in transit internal; do echo "$p $(ls "$RUN_ROOT/done/$p/{{ $json.runId }}/"*.json 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.result\.json$' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; done; echo "===LOGS==="; cat "$RUN_ROOT/logs/transit/{{ $json.runId }}/"*.ndjson "$RUN_ROOT/logs/internal/{{ $json.runId }}/"*.ndjson 2>/dev/null || true

RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; mkdir -p "$RUN_ROOT/summaries"; printf '%s' '{{ $json.jsonBase64 }}' | base64 -d > "$RUN_ROOT/summaries/{{ $json.runId }}.json"; printf '%s' '{{ $json.mdBase64 }}' | base64 -d > "$RUN_ROOT/summaries/{{ $json.runId }}.md"; echo "report {{ $json.runId }}"

parameters.text: =Repo scan {{ $json.runId }} finished: {{ $json.doneChunks }}/{{ $json.expectedChunks }} chunks done, {{ $json.failedRepos.length }} failed repos, {{ $json.missingChunks }} missing.

parameters.command: RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; DAYS="{{ $env.PURGE_AFTER_DAYS || '14' }}"; find "$RUN_ROOT/done" "$RUN_ROOT/jobs" "$RUN_ROOT/logs" "$RUN_ROOT/manifests" -type f -mtime "+$DAYS" -delete 2>/dev/null; find "$RUN_ROOT/summaries" -name '*.json' -mtime "+$DAYS" -delete 2>/dev/null; echo "purged >$DAYS days"
